[1/3] Build tools/build_dossier_media.py: fetch each repository's logo and social preview at its HEAD commit, optimize to WebP, record digest/size/date/source in schema-2 manifests, sanitize captions and verify offline

impact_assessment.why: Dossiers had no preview, logos were hand-copied, and no manifest was tied to a commit or checked against its file
impact_assessment.benefits: Every dossier shows the project's own logo and social card with verifiable provenance; CI catches drift
impact_assessment.risks: contract: media schema 2 and dossier state; dependency: Pillow for maintenance only; concurrency: reviewed logos must not be overwritten; state: 35 manifests and about 1MB of previews
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve committed logos, sanitize captions, offline check mode in CI, tests for schema and manifest consistency

[1/2] Record exact repository casing for two media folders/manifests in git and make the media checker reject case-mismatched paths

impact_assessment.why: Git missed the case-only renames, so GitHub Pages served Neurocore.json while the dossier requested NeuroCore.json
impact_assessment.benefits: Media resolves on case-sensitive hosting; the checker catches the class of bug on Windows too
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: two renames
impact_assessment.mitigation: Two-step git mv, exact-path validation, offline check run
